intro: Drag the points along the outline and watch d change. What you don't touch gets rewritten exactly as it was — that's why the result stays readable instead of turning into a wall of cubics.
trazos: This icon has {{n}} strokes. Click one to edit its nodes.

pluma.blancoPista: Draw with the pen tool below, or paste your own d — jumps to that field.
pluma.entrar: Pen tool: draw a new stroke
pluma.aviso: Pen tool — click to place points.
pluma.avisoAbierto: Finish as an open line, or keep clicking for a closed shape.
pluma.avisoCerrar: Click the first point to close, or:
pluma.moverTodo: drag a node — moves its whole stroke together, not just that point

capas.unico: This is the only stroke in view
capas.soloVista: Hiding only affects the view: exporting and saving keep the whole icon.
capas.tipArrastre: Drag a node to move it.
capas.tipAlt: Hold Alt to drag the whole stroke.
capas.tipFino: Hold Shift and the arrow keys move in steps of 0.1.

leyenda.nodo: node — drag it to move the point
leyenda.manija: bézier handle — bends the curve into it
leyenda.silueta: the icon's real stroke, dimmed so the nodes stay reachable underneath

nodo.pista: Select a node to edit it.

salida.pathEditableAria: Path data (d) — editable, paste a d to load that shape
salida.pathPegarPista: Paste a d here to load that shape.
salida.enlaceLargo: This shape is too big for a link — use the .json file instead.

coreografiar.nota: Carries the edited geometry to the Lab with the original choreography: the tracks point at the same shapes, so the animation that already existed runs on the new form.

borradores.soloAqui: Drafts live in this browser only. Clearing site data removes them.

angosto.texto: The node editor needs at least 900px of width for dragging to stay precise. Here's the icon and its current shape — open this page on a wider window to edit it.
